## Add 'change in symptom severity and number of symptoms' to data frame for each 5min increment during intervention
```{r}

selected_cols <- names(techs)[str_detect(names(techs), paste0("(", paste( collapse = "|"), "_int1_d5_d36$", ")"))]

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[5:24]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_1_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min5_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_1_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[29:48]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_2_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min10_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_2_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[52:72]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_3_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min15_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_3_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[76:96]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_4_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min20_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_4_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, selected_cols[100:120]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_5_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min25_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_5_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[124:144]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  severity_change_6_int1_d36 = rowSums(.[, "min30_cif_int36"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_int1_d5_d36", drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
  numb_symps_6_int1_d36 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[148:167]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

```


## Add same thing to BESTT baseline
```{r}
selected_cols <- techs |> 
  dplyr::select("headache", "neckpain", "dizziness_vomiting", "pressure", 
                "blurred_vision", "balance_problems", "light_sensitive", 
                "noise_sensitive", "slow", "fog", "feeling_right", 
                "concentration", "remembering", "fatigue", "confusion", 
                "drowsiness", "emotional", "irritability", "sleep", 
                "sadness", "anxiety", "nausea") |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(replace(., is.na(.), 0))))

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  bestt_severity_change_baseline = rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif"], na.rm = TRUE),
  bestt_numb_symps_baseline =rowSums(.[, names(selected_cols[1:22])] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

```

## Add same thing to BESTT everything else
```{r}

selected_cols <- names(techs)[str_detect(names(techs), paste0("(", paste( collapse = "|"), "_12$", ")"))]

view(selected_cols)

techs <- techs %>% mutate(
  bestt_severity_change_12 = rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif_12"], na.rm = TRUE) - rowSums(.[, "baseline_cif"], na.rm = TRUE),
  bestt_numb_symps_12 =rowSums(.[, selected_cols[5:26]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

writexl::write_xlsx(techs, "techs_BESTT_all2.xlsx")
```
